scripts.build: echo 'No build step required for Railway'
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T app npm run db:migrate
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T psql -U tes_user_dev -d tes_mvp_dev -c "DROP SCHEMA public CASCADE; CREATE SCHEMA public;"
scripts.db:seed:dev: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T app npm run db:seed
scripts.db:setup:dev: docker-compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T app npm run db:setup
